worldcombat.skill.amnesia.summary: Temporarily raises Special Defence and clears confusion, infatuation, taunt, torment, encore and disable. Its Special Defence contribution ends with the clarity window.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.use.0: Forget confusion, infatuation and the like the moment they land
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.use.1: Pad Sp. Def before taking a special attacker's fire
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.use.2: Touch up Sp. Def with a momentary blank in a long trade
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.description.0: Amnesia raises Special Defense by %1$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.deep.on: Deep amnesia clears all six listed effects and lasts longer, with 5 extra wind-up ticks and x1.25 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.deep.off: Brief lapse clears the first present effect in the listed order, with a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.description.2: Clears up to %1$s effects, in this order: confusion, infatuation, taunt, torment, encore, disable.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.growth.0: At level %1$s the blank lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.growth.1: At level %1$s the blank reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.preference.dee: On: clears confusion, infatuation, taunt, torment, encore and disable; longer clarity, 5 extra wind-up ticks and x1.25 cooldown. Off: clears the first present effect in that order with a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
Consider a blank when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
